problem_type: Planned dependency omitted from reference readiness
symptom: Original image-plus-video storyboard rows show missing first frame and are excluded from the original batch button despite planning a generated first frame.
direct_cause: missingRequiredSlots counts referenceBindings and visual anchors but ignores the first_frame edge that buildShotRowNodes already creates for an enabled video keyframe.
class_root: Shared readiness must count dependency outputs that the existing materializer and wave runner supply, without claiming other missing reference roles are satisfied.
affected_population: Legacy and Run-hosted storyboard plans with non-image shots and enabled generated keyframes
internal_only_reason: The invariant belongs to the repository's existing storyboard materializer, role declarations and dependency runner; no external runtime defines this behavior.
invariants: A non-image shot with keyframe.enabled true supplies one planned first_frame source; it supplies no other role.
Planned and bound first frames are alternative single-value sources, never additive credit.
Disabled keyframes and image shots retain ordinary required-slot validation.

door_reduction.why_not: Copied the complete shotRowModel file door-map output. Model resolution, override projection and visual-reference consumers remain necessary and unchanged; the sole missingRequiredSlots caller already centralizes row and batch readiness. No alternative entry is introduced.

generality_proof: Role-based first_frame credit follows the same non-image and enabled predicates as buildShotRowNodes for every declared model. Math.max prevents duplicate credit, while all other slot minima and existing anchor checks remain enforced.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive required reference readiness from existing bindings, visual anchors and one planned first-frame dependency.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls missingRequiredSlots for row missing-required state; both original editor hosts consume this projection.
Excludes missing-required rows from the original batch; corrected shared readiness feeds its existing runnable list.
Already creates or reuses the planned keyframe and emits first_frame; no new execution path is needed.

recurrence.reason: Any required first_frame model can reject a valid generated dependency in either original editor host.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs missingRequiredSlots: one caller in storyboardRowStatus
node scripts/door-map.mjs deriveShotRowExec: followed wrapper to deriveStoryboardRowRuntimes
Read buildShotRowNodes, runStoryboardBatch and generationReferenceResolver: generated image precedes video and supplies the first_frame role
Compared true merge-base 1d7c1e2a5e75f49daf392a3ec08a7841e7128e4f: shotRowModel unchanged; this readiness defect predates this branch

prevention.invariant: Existing planned first-frame dependency contributes at most one source exclusively to first_frame.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing tail frames or other required roles remain missing-required; disabled keyframes and image shots receive no planned credit.
prevention.strategy: Correct the existing shared readiness owner instead of filtering statuses at the button or adding a new runner.

legacy_paths.rationale: Fix the original shared predicate in place; original editor, materializer and runner remain the only implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal readiness projection, independent of React, Electron and provider versions.

migration: No stored-data migration. Existing plans already carry keyframe.enabled and are re-derived on read.
residual_risks: Focused tests use controlled catalog and supplier boundaries; actual Electron batch red/green and screenshots are tracked separately by the integration owner.
This change does not resolve full T7 module-load recovery or establish Windows verification.
